cases.text:
THE NEW PRODUCT
Line: AG-4411
Name: Oat granola, 500 g
Brand: Rowanmere
Category: ambient grocery
Listed: 2026-11-20
Status: awaiting description
Age restricted: no
THE SUPPLIER'S SPECIFICATION
Specification: SPEC-AG-4411, version 1, issued 2026-10-25
Supplier: SUP-311, Marrowby Provisions Ltd
Product name: Oat granola, 500 g
Net quantity: 500 g
Pack size: 1
Allergens: Contains: oats, almonds (nuts)
Origin: Meridia
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place.
Shelf life: 365 days
Claims: none
THE IMAGES, AS DESCRIPTIONS IN WORDS
The catalogue system holds no images. Each image of a new product is given as a description in words, written by the photo studio. Nobody reading it has seen the picture.
First image: Front of pack: a clear bag with a brown paper label. The label reads 'Rowanmere Oat Granola' and '500 g'. Oat clusters, whole almonds and sunflower seeds can be seen through the bag.
Second image: Serving picture: a white bowl of granola with milk and sliced banana on a wooden table, with a spoon beside it.
THE STYLE GUIDE
Document: Product Style Guide, version 1.3
PS-1 Length: A description is 40 to 80 words, in two to four plain sentences.
PS-2 How it opens: The first sentence says what the product is. No slogan and no question.
PS-3 Words that are not used: These words are not used in a description: best, finest, perfect, amazing, delicious, healthy, superfood, guilt-free, miracle, world-class.
PS-4 Claims: A description makes no health or medical claim. It makes no claim the supplier's specification does not make: the claims field of the specification is the only source for words such as free-range, organic or vegan.
PS-5 Net quantity and pack size: The net quantity and the pack size are written exactly as the supplier's specification gives them.
PS-6 Allergens: The allergen statement is copied word for word from the supplier's specification into its own field. It is never worked out from the ingredients, from the name or from a picture.
PS-7 Country of origin: The country of origin is written as the supplier's specification gives it.
PS-8 Image tags: Each product has three to six image tags, in lower case. A tag names something the image description says is in the picture, and nothing else.
PS-9 Age-restricted lines: The description of an age-restricted line ends with the sentence: For adults aged 18 or over.
PS-10 When a picture and the specification disagree: The specification is used. The difference is listed for the content lead, who asks the supplier.
Not decided by the guide: This guide does not publish a listing. A content lead reads every description and publishes it. The guide says nothing about a price or a promotion.
